sloka: वृतः कोटि सहस्रेण हरीणाम् समवस्थितः ।एषैवाशम्सते लङ्काम् स्वेनानीकेन मर्दितुम् ॥६-२७-२४॥।।
transliteration: vṛtaḥ koṭi sahasreṇa harīṇām samavasthitaḥ ।eṣaivāśamsate laṅkām svenānīkena marditum ॥6-27-24॥।।

translations.english: "He is surrounded with thousand crores of his Vanara force and with his own force he intends to crush Lanka."
